verdict.rationale: The skills' source is publicly readable in the official anthropics/skills GitHub repo. A hands-on probe fetched it without an Anthropic account, and community users cite reading the xlsx SKILL.md there. However, no evidence names an open-source license for the repo; the 'open standard' claim covers the specification, not a license on the source. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open license (e.g., an SPDX license file) on the repository, and confirmation that the license covers all skills including the document skills.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
